info.title: CivicPay implementation API
info.description: Synthetic municipal payment records only. Set X-Api-Key outside explicit local demo mode. Dates use UTC; amounts are CAD decimals. See docs/API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md for examples and error codes.

get.summary: List municipality configurations and enabled payment types.

post.summary: Create a municipality. Currency must be CAD; minimum must be positive.

get.summary: Retrieve a municipality configuration including its update version.

put.summary: Update configuration. Supply the version returned by GET; stale updates return 409.

get.summary: Retrieve payment types enabled for this municipality.

post.summary: Upload accounts or payments CSV. Rows are validated independently, with persisted rejection details.

get.summary: Retrieve totals, amount completeness, difference and reconciliation status.
Retrieve a batch's inspected rows. Maximum page size is 200.
Dashboard snapshot filtered by municipality, inclusive UTC dates and Accepted/Rejected request outcome.
Inspect synthetic account balances for an integration test or onboarding.

post.summary: Accept a synthetic payment. Identical retries return 200 and replayed=true; new records return 201.

get.summary: Retrieve an accepted transaction by its identifier.

ApiKey.description: Required unless Demo:OpenAccess is enabled locally.
